text: In Odoo Sales, create a new quotation (Sales > Orders > Quotations > New). Set the customer to 'fwod98-n1 Bench Customer' - it is an autocomplete field, so type the name and actually select the matching option from the dropdown. Then add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue (type in the product field and select an option from the dropdown), and set its quantity to 3. Let the app fill in the unit price automatically from the product's list price - do not type a price yourself. Save the quotation. Report back: the product name you chose, the unit price the app filled in on the line, and the Untaxed Amount the app computes (as shown in the order's totals).
